payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation, including the use of section title embeddings and classified section title embeddings.

claims.text: Section titles are encoded using section title embeddings (STE) by summing the last hidden states of tokenized titles, or classified STEs by replacing intraclass STEs with class embeddings.
Classified STEs are used when section titles belong to predefined classes, while original STEs are used for titles that do not fit any class.
The method groups similar section titles into classes, enhancing the encoding process by recognizing semantic similarities among titles.
